playback.caption: Walk: the commanded walk (body held in place; it travels 78 mm in the simulation)

notes: walk (4-beat crawl): 2 cycles of 1.2 s, step 40 mm, lift 25 mm (feet impacts: forces are estimates)
foot slip is not measured: the floor friction is MuJoCo's default (1.0)
accuracy: Guide only: rigid bodies (link compliance and gear backlash ignored).

Servos are a PD model (stall at about 3 deg of error); 'servo' is what a stiff position servo draws tracking the motion, 'ideal' is inverse dynamics of the motion the robot actually made. Sizing uses the larger.
Contacts are soft (MuJoCo): impact peaks depend on contact stiffness and are estimates; static and quasi-static results are accurate (exact on the 2-link check).
Mass is B-rep volume x density (exact for solid parts); infill, fasteners and wiring (+5-10%) are not included unless modelled.
